speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Femoral Neck Fracture

Your history of immediate, severe right groin pain following a rear-end collision, combined with abnormal leg positioning, strongly suggests a femoral neck fracture. Can you tell me if you are currently unable to bear any weight on your right leg, and is the affected leg shortened and rotated outward compared to the left?
